name: TotalSegmentator: Anatomical Structure Segmentation in CT Images
description: TotalSegmentator is a foundational open-source computed tomography (CT) segmentation dataset and toolkit developed by researchers at the Department of Radiology, University Hospital Basel. Published in Radiology: Artificial Intelligence, the dataset provides voxel-level ground-truth segmentations of 104 to 117 vital anatomical structures (including 27 organs, 59 bones, 10 muscles, and 8 vessels) across 1,204 randomly sampled clinical CT examinations (version 1) and expanded to 1,939 CT scans (version 3) from diverse pathologies, scanners, and imaging protocols. Available on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, TotalSegmentator is widely used as a cornerstone dataset for full-body anatomical parsing, organ volumetry, and opportunistic screening in diagnostic CT.
